page_title: LEC 2-1 UDI | Lecce v Udinese 08/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+4' Udinese enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jesper Karlstrom departs the field of play to be replaced by Adam Buksa (Udinese).
90+2' Substitution. Jamil Siebert (Lecce) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Omri Gandelman walks off.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' 2 - 1 Lameck Banda (Lecce) takes a wonderful free kick and curls the ball into the top left corner with an absolutely phenomenal strike!
89' Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Antonio Rapuano had an easy-decision to make. Lecce are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
87' OFF THE WOODWORK! Omri Gandelman (Lecce) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot that smashes against the crossbar!
86' Today's match ends for Kingsley Ehizibue who will be replaced by Christian Kabasele (Udinese).
86' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Oier Zarraga (Udinese) replaces Jurgen Ekkelenkamp.
84' Antonio Rapuano shows a yellow card to Lameck Banda (Lecce) for his blatant foul.

81' Konan Ndri (Lecce) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
80' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) goes for goal with a shot from long range, but the effort flies painfully wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
79' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
77' Here is a change. Riccardo Sottil is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Konan Ndri (Lecce).
77' Walid Cheddira goes off the pitch and Nikola Stulic (Lecce) comes on.
76' Oumar Solet (Udinese) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
74' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
71' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lecce, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
70' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. A free kick has been awarded to Lecce.
68' Substitution. Santiago Pierotti is replaced by Lameck Banda (Lecce).
67' Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
65' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
64' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) has tested the patience of referee Antonio Rapuano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
64' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Vakoun Issouf Bayo will be replaced by Idrissa Gueye (Udinese).
64' Substitution. Lennon Miller will be replaced by Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese).
63' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
62' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lecce are going to take it.
62' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) makes a weak connection with the corner kick, and his close-range header is easily blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Lecce will have a corner.
62' The ball goes behind for a corner. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
62' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) sends a rebound goalwards towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper stretches to stop it. Lecce will take a corner kick.
61' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
60' Great teamplay by Lecce as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
57' Neat passing move from Udinese in order to create new attacking opportunities.
54' Maduka Okoye makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the top left corner by Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) after a cross from the side.
53' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Riccardo Sottil (Lecce).
51' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
49' Arthur Atta (Udinese) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
48' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lecce, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Lecce can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
43' The ball possession at the moment is 45:55.
41' Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

38' Arthur Atta (Udinese) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles wide of the right post. Nice run, but poor finish! The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.

36' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
35' The Lecce players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
33' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Antonio Rapuano who sees an offensive foul.
32' Udinese seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
29' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Tiago Gabriel (Lecce), but it's just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
29' The referee signals a corner kick to Lecce.

29' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play and Lecce manage to earn a corner.
28' Lecce take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
26' 1 - 1 Goal! Oumar Solet (Udinese) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Wladimiro Falcone into the bottom right corner.
26' Oumar Solet (Udinese) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
26' Referee Antonio Rapuano is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Udinese!
25' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Udinese using VAR. Let's see what happens.

24' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle after Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to Udinese!
22' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
20' Rough tackle by Oumar Solet (Udinese). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
17' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lecce, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
15' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul.
14' A decent effort by Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) from a close-range free kick! His attempt flies narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
14' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) commits a rough foul. Antonio Rapuano stops the game and makes a call. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Lecce.
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lecce.
8' Udinese control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

5' 1 - 0 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Omri Gandelman (Lecce) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 1:0.
3' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
Antonio Rapuano will referee today's match.
